_note: First-run guide (guide.js) and Mr. Algo hints. A step: id, goal (the HUD goal line), say (one line from Mr. Algo when the step starts, optional), target (station: a station id; app: a phone app id; ui: a button key, see UI in guide.js), done (a condition id, see COND in guide.js). Optional ready + waitGoal: until ready holds, the goal line shows waitGoal and nothing is highlighted. A step whose done condition already holds is skipped, so a loaded game resumes at the right place. {from} {to} {cutoff} are the courier pickup times from shop.json. The affiliate start runs the affiliate steps, then the reseller steps. Hints are checked top to bottom when you ask Mr. Algo; the first whose conditions all hold is shown.

affiliate: Hi. I am Mr. Algo. I used to be a smart speaker.
You have a phone and a little cash. Let's start by promoting other sellers' products.
reseller: Hi. I am Mr. Algo. I used to be a smart speaker.
You have shelves and a packing table. Let's sell your own stock.

affiliate.goal: Request a free sample on the Affiliate site at the desk PC.
Your sample is on its way. Read the feeds while you wait.
affiliate.say: Watch what other sellers post. Nap at the bed to pass time.

affiliate.goal: The sample is at the door. Take it in.
Film the sample at the filming corner and post it.
Read your post's results on the phone.
affiliate.waitGoal: Your post is live. Views come in waves.

affiliate.goal: Buy Shelves and a packing table in the Tool Shop to sell your own stock.
affiliate.say: Commission is small. Your own stock pays more per sale, with more risk.

reseller.goal: Order stock on the Supplier site at the desk PC.
reseller.say: Watch the prices. They rise when a product gets popular.

reseller.goal: Your stock arrives at 9:00. Read the feeds meanwhile.
reseller.say: Nap at the bed to skip ahead.

reseller.goal: The supplier left boxes at the door. Take them in.
Put your stock on the shelves.
reseller.say: Only stock on a shelf can sell.

reseller.goal: Film a product at the filming corner and post it.
reseller.say: A video brings the buyers. Your stock on the shelves sells at its usual price.

reseller.goal: Pack your orders at the packing table.
reseller.waitGoal: Orders come from your posts. Wait for one.

reseller.goal: Book a courier pickup on Shofi (phone). Book before {cutoff} for today.
reseller.say: The courier comes once a day, some time between {from} and {to}.

reseller.goal: The courier is at the door. Hand over your parcels.
reseller.waitGoal: Be home between {from} and {to}. The courier waits only a short time.

reseller.goal: Read your post's results on the phone.
reseller.waitGoal: Your post is live. Views come in waves.

end: You know the loop now: read the market, post, pack, ship. Tap me any time for a hint.

hints.text: Open the desk PC. Go to the Affiliate site. Request a sample.
Your sample is on its way. Check the feeds while you wait, or nap to pass time.
Something is waiting at the door. Take it in.
The courier is at the door. Hand over your packed parcels before they leave.
Orders are waiting. Pack them at the packing table, then book a pickup on Shofi.
Film your product at the filming corner. Four short clips, then edit and post.
Open the results of your last post. I have three things to tell you.
Your post is live. Open the PC, then a site, then My posts to watch it.
You are tired. Nap or sleep at the bed.
Read the feeds. Look for products many people are asking about.
